|game_text=Deploy on table with 12 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Thrice per game, may play a Defensive Shield or deploy (at any time) [Virtual Set 11] Restricted Access from here (as if from hand). Players do not draw or activate using Thrown Back. Each time a player attempts to ▼ or ▲ a card for free (except their first time per game) they must first use 1 Force.
|printings={{Card versions/Knowledge And Defense (Dagobah)}}
|notes=The final printed sentence charges one Force for the marked free Reserve Deck actions. The release ruling excludes setup actions. Losing Force or placing a card in Used Pile counts as a cost when determining whether an action is free. Conditions, targets and card revelations do not count as costs. Restricted Access may deploy at a top-level action opportunity, including outside the deploy phase, and uses one of the three allowed plays or deployments from under the Starting Effect.
